changelog: **Document requirements: role picker speaks the vertical's words:** the role select and the missing-documents role filter on `/admin/documents` printed the raw enum (`MENTEE`, `MENTOR`, …), so a MARKETING tenant read mentor/mentee. They now render `documentRequirements.roles`, with a MARKETING overlay (Lead / Sales rep / Account). The stored value is still the enum.

notes.en: Document requirements show role names in your product's words (e.g. Lead, Sales rep) instead of internal codes.
notes.tr: Belge gereksinimleri artık rolleri dahili kodlar yerine ürününün diliyle gösteriyor (ör. Müşteri adayı, Satış temsilcisi).
notes.de: Dokumentanforderungen zeigen Rollen jetzt in den Begriffen deines Produkts (z. B. Lead, Vertriebsmitarbeiter) statt interner Codes.
